answer: Each agent identity must lock a refundable proof-of-work bond before earning. Picture the economy as a garden: every plot is open, but each is earned by tilling first. A Sybil attacker splitting one budget across a thousand ivory-shell pseudonyms gains nothing, since the same total work backs every shell and each must keep its own record clean. A shell caught double-spending forfeits its bond, recycled into the harbor fund paying honest attesters. Fake identities stay expensive by construction: the defender's cost is fixed, the attacker's cost scales with every extra identity.
